actions.value:
set +e
date -u +%FT%T.%N
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=2s 24s /bin/sh <<'ORIGINAL_ZOOM_ACTION_SOURCE'
PHASE=send-zoom-on-before-click
# Read-only observations bracketing ordinary input; PHASE is assembler supplied.
. /home/probe/session-env
set -u
failures=0
observe() {
  label=$1
  shift
  printf '\nORIGINAL_ZOOM_READ_START=%s:%s\n' "$PHASE" "$label"
  date -u +%FT%T.%N
  timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=1s 2s "$@"
  rc=$?
  printf 'ORIGINAL_ZOOM_READ_EXIT=%s:%s:%s\n' "$PHASE" "$label" "$rc"
  if test "$rc" -ne 0; then failures=$((failures + 1)); fi
}
observe uptime cat /proc/uptime
observe zoom-enabled gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.applications screen-magnifier-enabled
observe zoom-user-value dconf read /org/gnome/desktop/a11y/applications/screen-magnifier-enabled
observe magnifier-settings gsettings list-recursively org.gnome.desktop.a11y.magnifier
observe shell-stat cat /proc/34063/stat
observe shell-owner gdbus call --session --dest org.freedesktop.DBus --object-path /org/freedesktop/DBus --method org.freedesktop.DBus.GetNameOwner org.gnome.Shell
observe geometry /usr/bin/python3 /home/probe/source-input/geometry-oracle/snapshot-guest.py
observe editor-stat cat /proc/34918/stat
observe editor-exe readlink /proc/34918/exe
observe app-stat-before cat /proc/39607/stat
observe app-exe readlink /proc/39607/exe
observe app-exe-hash sha256sum /proc/39607/exe
observe app-status cat /proc/39607/status
observe app-flatpak-info cat /proc/39607/root/.flatpak-info
observe app-stat-after cat /proc/39607/stat
# Actual rendered caret and viewport captures are the primary GTK observation.
# No additional AT-SPI collector is started in this minimal ordinary UI round.
printf 'ORIGINAL_ZOOM_PHASE_COMPLETE=%s:failures=%s\n' "$PHASE" "$failures"
test "$failures" -eq 0
ORIGINAL_ZOOM_ACTION_SOURCE
rc=$?
printf 'ORIGINAL_ZOOM_WHOLE_EXIT=send-zoom-on-before-click:%s
' "$rc"
date -u +%FT%T.%N
exit "$rc"

set +e
date -u +%FT%T.%N
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=2s 82s /bin/sh <<'ORIGINAL_ZOOM_ACTION_SOURCE'
. /home/probe/session-env
set -u
source_dir=/home/probe/evidence/original-zoom-round15-source
out=/home/probe/evidence/original-zoom-round15
set +e
# This final restore follows ALL physical keys even if the sleeping fallback
# already expired. Both same-key writers restore the same saved null baseline.
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=2s 12s gjs "$source_dir/zoom-setting-cleanup.proposed.js" restore "$out/baseline.json" "$out/final-restore.json"
final_rc=$?
printf 'ORIGINAL_ZOOM_FINAL_RESTORE_EXIT=%s
' "$final_rc"
count=0
while ! test -s "$out/fallback-exit.txt" && test "$count" -lt 60; do
  sleep 1
  count=$((count + 1))
done
for name in baseline.json capture.json fallback-pid.txt fallback-launch-stat.txt fallback.log fallback-exit.txt fallback-restore.json final-restore.json; do
  printf '
ORIGINAL_ZOOM_RETAINED_FILE=%s
' "$name"
  timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=1s 2s cat "$out/$name"
  printf 'ORIGINAL_ZOOM_RETAINED_FILE_EXIT=%s:%s
' "$name" "$?"
done
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=1s 2s gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.applications screen-magnifier-enabled
printf 'ORIGINAL_ZOOM_FINAL_EFFECTIVE_EXIT=%s
' "$?"
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=1s 2s dconf read /org/gnome/desktop/a11y/applications/screen-magnifier-enabled
printf 'ORIGINAL_ZOOM_FINAL_USER_EXIT=%s
' "$?"
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=1s 2s gsettings list-recursively org.gnome.desktop.a11y.applications
printf 'ORIGINAL_ZOOM_FINAL_APPLICATION_SETTINGS_EXIT=%s
' "$?"
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=1s 2s gsettings list-recursively org.gnome.desktop.a11y.magnifier
printf 'ORIGINAL_ZOOM_FINAL_MAGNIFIER_SETTINGS_EXIT=%s
' "$?"
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=1s 2s /usr/bin/python3 /home/probe/source-input/geometry-oracle/snapshot-guest.py
printf 'ORIGINAL_ZOOM_FINAL_GEOMETRY_EXIT=%s
' "$?"
printf 'ORIGINAL_ZOOM_CLEANUP_COLLECTION_COMPLETE:final=%s
' "$final_rc"
test "$final_rc" -eq 0
ORIGINAL_ZOOM_ACTION_SOURCE
rc=$?
printf 'ORIGINAL_ZOOM_WHOLE_EXIT=cleanup:%s
' "$rc"
date -u +%FT%T.%N
exit "$rc"
